texts.IR_shipment_brief_0: Prevent Sirius from receiving twenty orbital station-support craft.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_intro: Contact Yokohama Exports through Aletius main orbital station services.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_answer_1: Twenty station-support craft are reserved for Sirius. Yokohama will divert the order to your client for1000000CR before calendar day{deadline}; otherwise the original reservation stands.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_answer_2: The order remains reserved until day{deadline}. Purchase and divert it to Ibanez at Vegedius for1000000CR, refuse the purchase and allow dispatch, or defer your decision.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_agreed: Payment received. The twenty-unit order is diverted to Ibanez account44-GC23-TS at Vegedius main orbital station. Report the result to GalCop.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_nomoney: Your available balance is below1000000CR. The order has not been purchased.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_defer: Decision deferred. The existing reservation deadline remains in force.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_declined: Yokohama will proceed with dispatch to Sirius. Track the convoy from Aletius if you intend to intercept it.
texts.IR_YOKOHAMA_shipment_toolate: The purchase window has expired. Yokohama has released the order for Sirius; report the failed interception.
texts.IR_shipment_brief_1: Resolve the reserved orbital-support order before calendar day{deadline}.
texts.IR_PIRATE_intro: Open a private station communication with pirate captain Alsto Abonlo at Edzaar.
texts.IR_PIRATE_intro_alt: Resume your station communication with Alsto Abonlo.
texts.IR_PIRATE_shipment_answer: The Sirius convoy carries the orbital-support order through Atmala towards Tevebebi. Abonlo can arrange an interception.
texts.IR_PIRATE_shipment_offer: Assistance costs a nominal250000CR, with an actual charge of{actualDebit}CR under this offer. Abonlo also claims surviving consignment goods. Destroyed goods bring no refund. Confirm assistance or decline.
texts.IR_PIRATE_shipment_accepted: Assistance agreed. Refuse Yokohama's purchase, observe the Aletius convoy, then relay its departure report from a main orbital station. Abonlo will prepare the Atmala ambush after the report.
texts.IR_PIRATE_shipment_confirm_help: The assistance deal is already paid. Relay an observed departure report to activate the agreed Atmala support.
texts.IR_PIRATE_shipment_deferred_help: You may reconsider assistance while the order is still reserved. Confirm the displayed actual debit once to proceed.
texts.IR_PIRATE_shipment_declined: No assistance purchased. Atmala remains the convoy interception point; you will have to handle its escorts yourself.
texts.IR_shipment_brief_2: Allow the convoy to leave Aletius; obtain and relay its departure report if you hired Abonlo.
texts.IR_shipment_contact_report: Relay the observed Aletius launch report: four armoured carriers, initially two escorts each, intended destination Tevebebi via Atmala. The report confirms an assigned carrier's actual departure; current survivors may differ.
texts.IR_transport_clear: Aletius Control: the assigned armoured convoy has flight clearance.
texts.IR_transport_identified: Assigned shipment carrier identified. Identification alone does not confirm departure.
texts.IR_transport_depart: An assigned convoy carrier has entered its recorded departure wormhole.
texts.IR_report_abonlo: A genuine departure is recorded. Relay the convoy report from a main orbital station.
texts.IR_prepare_ambush: Abonlo's reported support is active at Atmala. Intercept the assigned carriers in space.
texts.IR_ambush_abonlo: Assisted interception: prevent all four assigned carriers from delivering the consignment.
texts.IR_ambush_solo: Solo interception: prevent all four assigned carriers from delivering the consignment.
texts.IR_abonlo_report: The consignment cannot reach Sirius. Surviving goods remain subject to Abonlo's agreed claim; report the result to GalCop.
texts.IR_solo_ambush: All four carrier lots are prevented from delivery. Report the result to GalCop.
texts.IR_shipment_brief_3: Intercept the assigned Sirius convoy in Atmala.
texts.IR_shipment_brief_4: Relay the shipment result to Admiral Ibanez from a main orbital station.
texts.IR_shipment_success: GalCop records that Sirius has been denied the orbital-support order. Return to Vegedius after resolving the other investigation strands.
texts.IR_shipment_failure: GalCop records that the order was not stopped. Return to Vegedius after resolving the other investigation strands.
texts.IR_tipoff: An anonymous station message supplies an SDF bulletin identifying {shipName}'s registration in the shipment dispute. A genuine newly purchased registration can stop future pursuit generated by this investigation; existing attackers and ordinary legal status remain.
texts.IR_IBANEZ_5a: Ibanez ends your assignment: the exposed attack outside Aletius compromised the investigation. No further assignment or payment is authorized.
texts.IR_IBANEZ_5b: Ibanez ends your assignment because the orbital-support order was not stopped. No further assignment or payment is authorized.

project_messages.reservation-equality: The reservation decision is unavailable on its exact deadline day. No payment or dispatch has been recorded by this inquiry.
project_messages.blocked-departure: The convoy has not completed an observed departure. A blocked or rejected jump does not authorize a report.
project_messages.unreported-help: Assistance is paid, but no departure report reached Abonlo before this encounter. No helper fleet is active.
project_messages.gallery-read-only: Mission Gallery preview: commander property, people, cash, legal status and campaign progress are unchanged.

playable_text_overrides.scope: Per shipment instance/profile only; do not globally replace shared raw source message IDs used by finance/SDF/follow-up strands.
